summary: No fundamentals-based thesis is broken by the 2026-10-26 close. Every equity position with a quality thesis (DPZ, IDXX, WMT, FAST, CARG, KR, MSCI, VRSN) is within 1.1% of cost or in the green except CARG (-0.7%) and DPZ (-1.0%), both far from their stated invalidation levels, and close.json contains no filing, cash-flow or screen evidence that contradicts any of them.
update: Lessons L1 and L2 apply to the proposer, news-analyst and portfolio-manager, not to me, and graded_calls is empty, so there is no track record to adjust against. Watch items, none of which break a thesis. (1) DPZ: invalidation includes a screen reflecting the Q3 results reported 10-13 dropping it or showing cfo below net income. I have not seen a post-Q3 fundamentals refresh in the files I may read, so that condition is unverified rather than passed; position is -1.03% vs the $274.88 stop. (2) VRSN: the thesis (9/9 F-score, cfo well above net income) rests on fundamentals that the PM itself notes predate the 10-22 Q3 print; the guide-raise reversal condition is not triggered by anything in close.json, and the position is +4.6% after a +2.8% day. The 10-26 add at $303.08 raised cost basis versus the $292.23 first lot. (3) CARG: -0.7% on the combined position, -1.1% today, no adverse filing; earnings 11-05 is the next real test of the cfo-about-2x-net-income claim. (4) FAST, IDXX, KR, MSCI, WMT are all above cost with no contrary evidence. IDXX has earnings estimated 11-02 and a Jefferies price-target cut noted earlier, which is sentiment, not a fundamentals break. A single day's price move is not treated as evidence against any thesis.
